A_target.statement:
Let $f$ be [[Definition:Riemann Integrable Function|integrable]] on $\closedint a b$.
Then:
:$\displaystyle \size {\int_a^b \map f x \rd x} \le \int_a^b \size {\map f x} \rd x$

B_source.statement:
Let $g, h$ be [[Definition:Riemann Integrable Function|integrable]] on $\closedint a b$ with $g \le h$ pointwise.
Then:
:$\displaystyle \int_a^b g \le \int_a^b h$

validity_conditions: The pointwise inequalities -|f(x)| <= f(x) <= |f(x)| hold everywhere.
Monotonicity applied to each side gives -integral|f| <= integral f <= integral|f|.
A two-sided bound -c <= y <= c is equivalent to |y| <= c.
proof_plan: Apply [[Integral is Monotone|monotonicity of the integral]] to both inequalities.
